description: Detects LLM prompts built from user input or retrieved documents that let attackers hijack the model's instructions. Use when writing code that constructs LLM prompts from user input, builds system prompts, implements RAG pipelines, or processes external documents fed to a model. Also invoke when external data can influence LLM context.
